assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: finished Korean editorial blog thumbnail, one individual landscape image, 1536 by 1024 composition (3:2). Create a polished, understated editorial title graphic for a Korean corporate technology blog. This is one of a consistent four-image series.
Background and palette: warm ivory and muted sand, background #F0ECE3, charcoal lettering #292925, delicate beige accents. Absolutely no saturated, vivid, neon, primary-color or bright accent backgrounds. Matte, very pale low-saturation background, very subtle paper texture.
Text: render the following exact Korean text on EXACTLY THREE LINES, very large bold modern Korean sans-serif typography, dark high contrast, generous line height, optically aligned flush left, crisp perfectly legible Korean glyphs:
"유라클의 AI·모바일
네 가지 사업을
한눈에 살펴보기"
Text is the dominant element, roughly 65% of the composition. Use large 74–96px equivalent lettering, never tiny type. Keep every line fully inside a generous 9% outer safe margin. Do not wrap into additional lines. No extra title, no small subtitle, no footer, no logos, no watermarks.
Supporting visual: four distinct small sculptural icons grouped at the lower right: connected AI nodes, a server, a code window, and a mobile phone. No labels. Minimal tasteful monochromatic 3D paper/clay-like editorial illustration occupying at most 30% of the frame, separated from text, restrained soft shadows. The text must stay unobscured. Clean spacious corporate editorial aesthetic. Finished image, not a photo of a poster or mockup. No human figures, no charts with invented data.
